name: Credential Service Provider
title: Credential Service Provider — Scytáles
description: Trusted service between issuing authorities and mDL, mID, and wallet providers — establishing authenticity and provenance of digital credentials.

hero.headline: Seamless Communication Between Issuers and Wallet Providers
hero.sub: Scytáles Credential Service Provider (CSP) provides a trusted bridge between the issuer’s users and mDL, mID, and wallet providers — direct contact between External Registration Authority and CSP.
bullets: Establishes trust between Issuing Authorities and Relying Parties
Maintains public keys for issuing authorities
Scales for thousands of decentralised issuers

showcase.statCopy: Private keys stored in FIPS-140-2 Level 3 secured devices

features.body: Centralises issued key material in a master list so decentralised issuers and relying parties can verify authenticity and provenance of digital identity documents.
High-availability, database-driven setup with three nodes and NoSQL — built for regional and bilateral trust agreements at scale.
Security by design: two-factor login, SSL endpoints, proxy-secured communication, load balancing, and FIPS-140-2 Level 3 private-key storage.

discover.copy: NFC card authentication that derives credentials from security documents into mobile virtual IDs.
Carry official physical and digital credentials on your phone with EUDI-ready wallet support.
Authenticate a fleet of readers for secure online and offline data transfer from wallets and mIDs.

statement: Just as security features make a physical credential trustworthy, Scytáles CSP gives relying parties assurance of the authenticity and provenance of digital identity documents across issuers worldwide.
